GU_ZHEN_REN_CARDPILE_GU_CARDS.title: Gu Hand
GU_ZHEN_REN_CARDPILE_GU_CARDS.descriptio: The Gu Hand stores up to 5 usable Gu Worms. When space is available, recovered Gu are drawn in recovery order from the recovery pile. Killer Move deduction can use only Gu in this pile. Gu Worms can be played directly from this pile.
GU_ZHEN_REN_CARDPILE_GU_DISCARD.title: Gu Recovery Pile
GU_ZHEN_REN_CARDPILE_GU_DISCARD.descript: Stores cooling Gu and recovered Gu waiting because the Gu Hand is full. At turn start, vacancies are filled at random. Left-click to inspect.
GU_ZHEN_REN_CARDPILE_GU_DISCARD.empty: The Gu Recovery Pile is empty.
GU_ZHEN_REN_CARDPILE_GU_SEALED.title: Sealed Gu Pile
GU_ZHEN_REN_CARDPILE_GU_SEALED.descripti: Holds Strength Gu that have not finished training this combat, plus Gu Worms sealed into Killer Moves. Play their permanent companion cards to train them; at full progress they unseal into the Gu Hand. Materials return to the Gu Recovery Pile when the Killer Move is consumed or dismantled.
GU_ZHEN_REN_CARDPILE_GU_CARDS.selectionP: Select Gu Worm materials matching the selected Killer Move, then confirm.
GU_ZHEN_REN_CARDPILE_GU_CARDS.targetSele: First select the Killer Move to deduce. Only matching materials will be shown next.
